name: dauntless-assault-no-wake-up-without-mordred-champion
notes: Dauntless Assault (ixIY36Ck37): the wake up is a "[Mordred Bonus]" On Attack. With a non-Mordred champion (Tristan, Shadowdancer, whose UMBRA lineage enables the Exalted element) the same attack deals its 4 damage but the champion remains rested.

rulesClauses: The wake up is a [Mordred Bonus]: a non-Mordred champion stays rested after attacking.
